name: charla
description: Private chat rooms with a twisted Tic Tac Toe, synced over WebSockets

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "cross-env PORT=8000 npm run dev --prefix server" "cross-env PORT=3000 npm start --prefix client"
